visual_style: Vertical 9:16, warm natural daylight, gentle realistic cinematic look. A Pakistani government school: whitewashed walls, a plain green blackboard with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame. Nobody speaks to the camera; the narration is a voice-over.

narrator.name: off-screen narrator
narrator.description: An unseen Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties, warm, clear and confident; voice-over only, never shown on camera.

shots.visual: Early morning at a Pakistani government school: a woman teacher, seen from behind, unlocks a classroom door and opens the wooden shutters as golden light fills the empty room of desks.
A small staff room: three teachers sit around a table with open folders, one listens thoughtfully while another speaks quietly; papers blurred and unreadable.
After class, a woman teacher seen from the side sits at her desk writing in a small notebook, pauses to think, then looks across the empty desks with a calm smile.
A teacher training workshop in a school hall: rows of teachers taking notes while a trainer stands beside a plain chart stand with nothing written on it.

In a sunlit school corridor, a young woman trainee teacher holds a phone and scrolls a textbook page (screen blurred, unreadable), then looks up with a confident smile as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: پڑھانا صرف نوکری ہے یا ایک پیشہ؟ ایک اچھا استاد اصل میں کیا کرتا ہے؟
اس کورس میں آپ professional ethics، code of conduct اور اساتذہ کے national اور global standards پڑھیں گے۔
ایک effective اور reflective teacher کیسے بنتے ہیں، اور اس پیشے کے issues اور challenges کا سامنا کیسے کرتے ہیں۔
چھ units، پہلے دن سے continuous professional development تک، تاکہ آپ ساری زندگی سیکھتے رہیں۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔
